core.title: 9-7/8 Inch Mortise Skeleton Key Iron Art Lockset With Egg Knob, Acorn IWYBI

text.description_html:
Acorn IWYBI, Iron Art Egg Knob Interior Handleset

The square shape of the Acorn Made IWYBI Mortise Handleset gives it a timeless look. It would look just as great in a more modern home as it would leading into a room full of antiques. Made for interior doors, this is a skeleton key lockset. Using a skeleton key opens up the imagination to a world full of secret rooms and hidden treasures, just like the movies! The keys look old, but the mortise lock uses modern technology.

Iron Art is a unique line of products created by hand using the techniques of the traditional forge.

Double Cylinder: A knob operates the latch from both the interior and the exterior while a key operates the deadbolt from both sides of the door.

Also Available Matching 9-7/8 Inch Dummy Art Lockset With Egg Knob

Unlike a simple tubular latch, this is a mortise lock. They are extremely durable and have a tighter clearance tolerance. You know it's a mortise lock when you hear that heavy, smooth, solid 'click' when the door closes shut.

Features and Specifications of the Mortise Skeleton Key Lockset:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Height: 9-7/8"
  • Width: 2-3/8"
  • Projection: 2-1/2"
  • Knob Height: 2-1/2"
  • Knob Width: 1-1/2"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8" or 1-3/4"
  • Backset: 2-1/2"

When Selecting the Handing:

The handing actually refers to the mortise lock, rather than the knob.

Sold Individually
